name: Essays
purpose: Own the product meaning, capability ontology, DomainSpec-v2 construction chain, local writing runtime, and clean writing frontend for an Essays product based on Whisper without making the selected open-source substrate, generated ontology, runtime, or interface the Project itself.
scope: one private Essays product identity and product thesis under CyberAlchemy v2
Whisper as the starting writing capability and composition lifecycle
product and capability ontologies that preserve writing intent, artifact lifecycle, review, evidence, residue, and human authority
source-backed research and selection of one permissively licensed open-source writing system whose bounded features can be reused or stripped
a DomainSpec-v2 source model, compiled graph, generated system ontology, and Project-owned CAV2-D65 ConstructionBinding
a local runtime and clean frontend that implement the selected Essays product and capability ontology
validation evidence for deterministic construction, runtime behavior, frontend behavior, and authority boundaries
exclusions: treating Whisper, an upstream editor, a repository folder, a generated graph, or a running process as the Essays Project
copying or adapting open-source code before license, notice, provenance, and feature-boundary review
recreating every feature of the selected writing software or importing unrelated collaboration, publishing, billing, or hosting surfaces
allowing UI state, model output, validation, or generated material to promote definitions, ontology claims, or owner decisions
claiming CAV2-D65 construction completion before every exact stage identity and evidence reference closes
publication, hosted deployment, account systems, external synchronization, or production-readiness claims in the first local product vertical
challenge_route: Challenge Essays product meaning through the Essays Project owner and CyberAlchemy v2 product owner, Whisper interpretation through the Whisper capability owner, DomainSpec construction claims through the DomainSpec v2 owner, runtime claims through the Essays runtime owner, and upstream reuse through the selected source and license owners.
